utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you picked the book club title yet, Ira?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet — I’m still tossing around a few ideas. I should have one by the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, just keep me posted — I’d like to print the sign once you decide.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got tools and can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that. I’ve been a bit scattered, so I’ll check what the book club needs and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush, Noah — just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club’s been lively lately — I heard they’re picking a new read this week. Want me to tell you what’s on the shortlist?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please — but only if it’s not too many options. I’d like to know what they’re considering before I promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Just two main picks so far: a mystery everyone’s been buzzing about and a lighter contemporary novel. If you want, I can tell you which one seems to be leading.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — how’s the book club going, Opal?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s going well — we’re meeting at the community center on Maple Street this Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Nice, I’ll swing by Thursday evening at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? You should come by next time — I’ll make sure you get the invite.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d like that—please do invite me next time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll text you as soon as the next book club date is set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m glad you’re here. Want to talk book club plans for this week?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — what time are we meeting, and what book are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m thinking Thursday at 7 by the community room, and we’re discussing "The Midnight Library."

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — what’s the book club’s plan, and what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually show up a little late, but I’m in for the book club. Maybe check the date, time, and which book we’re starting with first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the date, time, and first book before we go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to help with book club plans—what time works best around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye—could we do 7:30 after school pickup? That should be easiest for most folks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7:30 works well for me after pickup. I’ll plan around that and let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the book club—what’s it been like so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s been really nice so far—small group, good coffee, and a lot of surprisingly fun book talk. We’re just getting to know each other, but it already feels easy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely—small and easy is exactly my speed. What book are you all reading right now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Kira — I’m a little behind, but I’m in for book club. What book are we on?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I think we’re on the one you mentioned last week — can you confirm the title? I want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sorry — I can’t remember the exact title offhand. It’s the one I mentioned last week, though; I’ll check and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might be able to make it—what book are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I should know that, shouldn’t I? Let me check and I’ll tell you in a sec.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No rush — just let me know when you can. I’m curious either way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the others and circle back about the book club plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just let me know what everyone thinks, and I’ll keep an eye on the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask around and let you know what the group decides.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice, how’s the book club going? I’m always happy to hear what everyone’s reading.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going well—mostly just a small, thoughtful group so far. We’ve been talking about a mystery novel this week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds lovely—mystery novels always make for good discussion. What did everyone think of it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m a bit scattered today. What are we reading again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re reading the one I mentioned last week — I’ll remind you of the title again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, please — I’d appreciate the reminder. My brain’s a sieve today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the book club? I might’ve missed a thing or two, but I’m still in. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re meeting Thursday at 7 at the community center. I’ll send the book title and reminder later today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks—Thursday at 7 works for me. I’ll watch for the title and reminder later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if the book club needs anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. I’ll bring it up at the next meeting and let you know what we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — just let me know, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d be glad to help with book club—what are we reading first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! Let’s start with a novel everyone can talk about—how about we pick something lively and meet next Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great to me—I’m in for next Tuesday. Want me to help pick a lively novel?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’d love to hear how the book club’s going — are you all reading anything good this month?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re reading a mystery this month, and we’re meeting over at the community center on Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh nice, a mystery sounds fun — I might swing by the community center on Thursday if I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m glad we’re finally talking book club. Want to pick a book together or settle the meeting time first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa! Let’s pick the book first, then we can settle the meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ve got a few good options in mind, or we can go with something everyone’s been meaning to read. Want something light, something thought-provoking, or a little of both?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the book club is meeting again soon — did you get the details? I’d love to know what they’re reading.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t gotten the details yet, but I can ask around and let you know. If you hear back first, send me the title too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I will — I’m usually the last to hear, so I’ll keep my ears open too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club — sounds good. What book are we reading?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not totally sure yet — I need to check the school newsletter. I’ll let you know as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — just let me know when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help—what’s the book club planning this week?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so are we actually reading the same book this week, or did that change again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think it changed again—we’re all on the same page now, though. I can check the latest pick if you want.
